name: exovault-s4-trigger
description: Soft-trigger companion plugin for exo-compact: fires session.compact from turn.complete once context usage crosses the configured threshold. It is a separate plugin because Claude Code accepts only one hook module per plugin.

softThresholdPercent.title: Soft compaction threshold
softThresholdPercent.description: Context usage percentage that triggers S4 compaction after a completed turn.

compactWindowTokens.title: Compaction window
compactWindowTokens.description: Token size of the compaction window the soft threshold is measured against, independent of the model's actual context window.
